decisions.reason: It remains a low-cost option close to established space camera lines, so uncertainty about customer adoption still justifies keeping it.
The modular line offers multiple real options across models, and maintaining flexibility is cheap until demand signals clear.
Miniaturized LiDAR still holds significant future payoff under high technical uncertainty, so the firm keeps monitoring progress despite low website visibility.
The radiation-hard camera line is close to the established offer and new enough that its option value remains high and exit costs would outweigh early withdrawal.
The asteroid navigation camera is a niche, building-on offer with only a website mention and no clear demand signal, so its real option value no longer justifies continued commitment.
